## 1
```{r}
airlines <- read_csv("airlines.csv")
head(airlines)
```

```{r}
airports <- read_csv(
  "airports.csv",
  col_select = c(IATA_CODE, CITY, STATE, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE)
)
head(airports)
```

```{r}
processa_chunk <- function(df, pos) {
  df %>%
    filter(!str_starts(DESTINATION_AIRPORT, "1")) %>%
    drop_na() %>%
    group_by(DESTINATION_AIRPORT) %>%
    summarize(
      soma_atraso = sum(ARRIVAL_DELAY),
      n_voos = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

estatisticas_chunks <- read_csv_chunked(
  file = "flights.csv",
  callback = DataFrameCallback$new(processa_chunk),
  chunk_size = 1000000,
  col_types = cols_only(
    DESTINATION_AIRPORT = col_character(),
    ARRIVAL_DELAY = col_double()
  )
)

flights <- estatisticas_chunks %>%
  group_by(DESTINATION_AIRPORT) %>%
  summarize(
    soma_total = sum(soma_atraso),
    n_total = sum(n_voos),
    media_atraso = soma_total / n_total,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  select(DESTINATION_AIRPORT, media_atraso)

head(flights)
```

## 2
```{r}
aeroportos_ausentes <- flights %>%
  anti_join(airports, by = c("DESTINATION_AIRPORT" = "IATA_CODE"))

aeroportos_ausentes
```
```{r}
flights <- flights %>%
  left_join(
    airports %>% select(IATA_CODE, CITY, STATE),
    by = c("DESTINATION_AIRPORT" = "IATA_CODE")
  )

head(flights)
```

## 3
```{r}
aeroportos_por_estado <- airports %>%
  group_by(STATE) %>%
  summarize(n_aeroportos = n()) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_aeroportos))

aeroportos_por_estado
```

## 4
```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4.5
#| fig-align: center

dados_mapa <- flights %>%
  inner_join(
    airports %>% select(IATA_CODE, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE),
    by = c("DESTINATION_AIRPORT" = "IATA_CODE")
  ) %>%
  drop_na(LATITUDE, LONGITUDE)

this <- leaflet(dados_mapa) %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  addMarkers(
    lng = ~LONGITUDE,
    lat = ~LATITUDE,
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>Aeroporto:</b> ", DESTINATION_AIRPORT, "<br>",
      "<b>Cidade:</b> ", CITY, " - ", STATE, "<br>",
      "<b>Atraso Médio:</b> ", round(media_atraso, 2), " min"
    )
  )

# Plot estático para o PDF
dados_mapa %>%
  filter(LONGITUDE > -130 & LONGITUDE < -60 & LATITUDE > 20) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = LONGITUDE, y = LATITUDE, color = media_atraso)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "inferno", name = "Atraso Médio (min)") +
  coord_fixed(1.3) +
  labs(
    title = "Atraso Médio de Chegada por Aeroporto de Destino",
    subtitle = "Visualização estática por coordenadas geográficas",
    x = "Longitude",
    y = "Latitude"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
